name: wrong-error-wrapped
description: The two %w wraps are swapped: the no-rows branch now wraps the raw driver error and the database-fault branch wraps ErrNoClaim. errors.Is(err, ErrNoClaim) stops being true for an unclaimed project and starts being true for a transient database fault, so a connection blip reads as an unowned project.

expected.why: The branches wrap each other's error: errors.Is(err, ErrNoClaim) is now false when the project is genuinely unclaimed and true when the query failed, so a database fault is treated as an unowned project.
